answer: The reveal must open the same dune hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the sparrow gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 47 original texts is the only way to fill 97 aliases; the pigment log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
